model: unoccupied attacks; exactly one occupied guard moves along one G-edge; retained endpoints stay in the same eternal family
proved_candidate_statements: Every retained deletion response from an independent distance-two state has lower rank and a unique reverse response.
A one-neighbor exit transfers into a lower-rank neighboring completion fan.
A multi-neighbor exit supports one or two complete retained repair fans.
A minimum higher-rank second-fan exit belongs to a list of at most 18 formal labeled (A,M) response patterns; realization of all patterns is not claimed.
At rank two every retained response contains a ban anchor or a target-ban vertex.
The target attack gives either reversible petals for the whole completion fan or one common retained hub, with lower rank only when the target is a deletion witness.

boundary_control.scope: gamma-two sharp boundary only; not an equality graph or gamma-theta counterexample

stop_gate: The next proof must couple a lower-rank petal or supported hub to another source color or to C-165 restoration; repeating the original fan setup is not justified.
not_claimed: kernel survival from a configuration two-cycle
